name: Jagged Crown (Faunal)
body:
Antlers sprout from your forehead, challenging foes and milliners alike.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Fauna, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): Gain a natural gore attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage for a medium user, or 1D6 if they are small. Using these antlers are slightly awkward, causing the user to suffer -1 to AC on any round where a gore attack with the horns is made.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
